title: Descent of a finite coefficient-compatible pullback square
statement: Fix a prime l, an algebraic closure Ω of Q_l, schemes X,Y with l invertible, f:Y→X, and scheme automorphisms eX,eY. Use the rational and common-stage pullbacks [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], finite coefficient categories and stage inclusions [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], and normalized pullback transitions β [lem-pod-common-stage-pullback-normalized-descent]. Suppose that for every finite coefficient stage E we are given a natural isomorphism b_E: f_E^* ⋙ eY_E^* ≅ eX_E^* ⋙ f_E^*, and that T_Y(b_E) β_f f_L(β_eX) = β_eY eY_L(β_f) b_L(T_X K) for every inclusion E≤L and object K at E, with the object positions as in the Lean statement. Then there is a unique natural isomorphism between the two composites of common-stage pullbacks whose component at the literal pair (E,K) is the inclusion of (b_E)_K. No assertion that a prescribed integral square satisfies the finite compatibility equation is included.

proof.text: Use the normalized descent theorem for f, eX and eY to express the three actual common-stage pullbacks as functors of coherent stage morphisms. The two composite stage morphisms have the rational functor composites as their finite parts. The asserted finite compatibility is exactly the Hom.comm equation between them.

proof.text: Apply the proved generic descNatTrans construction to this Hom. Its components are inclusions of the finite components. isIso_descNatTrans applies because every finite component is an isomorphism. Conjugate by functorCompIso on both sides to obtain a comparison of the two actual composites of descended functors. These functorCompIso comparisons have identity components, so the prescribed component formula follows.

lean.statement:
theorem commonStagePullbackSquare_existsUnique
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra ℚ_[l] Ω] [IsAlgClosure ℚ_[l] Ω]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (f : Y ⟶ X) (eX : Aut X) (eY : Aut Y)
    (b : ∀ E : Index l Ω,
      rationalDerivedPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) f ⋙
        rationalDerivedPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) eY.hom ≅
      rationalDerivedPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) eX.hom ⋙
        rationalDerivedPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) f)
    (hb : ∀ {E L : Index l Ω} (w : E ≤ L)
      (K : GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Stage l Ω X E),
      ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.stageSystem l Ω Y).T w).map
          ((b E).hom.app K) ≫
        (commonStagePullbackTransition l Ω f w).hom.app
          ((rationalDerivedPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) eX.hom).obj K) ≫
        (rationalDerivedPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) f).map
          ((commonStagePullbackTransition l Ω eX.hom w).hom.app K) =
      ((commonStagePullbackTransition l Ω eY.hom w).hom.app
          ((rationalDerivedPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) f).obj K) ≫
        (rationalDerivedPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) eY.hom).map
          ((commonStagePullbackTransition l Ω f w).hom.app K)) ≫
        (b L).hom.app (((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.stageSystem l Ω X).T w).obj K)) :
    ∃! d : commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω f ⋙ commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω eY.hom ≅
        commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω eX.hom ⋙ commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω f,
      ∀ K : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω X,
        HEq (d.hom.app K)
          ((GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusion
            (l := l) (Ω := Ω) (Y := Y) K.stage).map ((b K.stage).hom.app K.obj))
